answer: Under Section 205 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Chapter 12: OF OFFENCES BY OR RELATING TO PUBLIC SERVANTS), wearing garb or carrying token used by public servant with fraudulent intent. Whoever not being a public servant wears any garb or carries any token resembling that used by a public servant with fraudulent intent shall be punished with imprisonment up to 3 months or fine up to 500 rupees or both.
